Use LIFO: newest for pop/peek. Empty pop/peek returns null. When full, drop the oldest stored value before accepting a push. push returns a boolean for acceptance. Capacity 0 rejects every push. peek does not remove an item. Return JSON-compatible values. Do not modify the input. Change only candidate.py.
